segments.text: Compress gas cylinders, installation and removal of a regulator.
segments.zh: 压缩气瓶：减压阀的安装与拆卸。

segments.text: Before installing your regulator, know the properties and hazards of the gas you are using.
segments.zh: 在安装减压阀之前，要了解你所使用气体的性质和危害。

segments.text: The safety data sheet should have this information, or you can contact the manufacturer.
segments.zh: 安全数据表上应有这些信息，或者你可以联系制造商。

segments.text: Secure the gas cylinder with a chain or appropriate belt above the midpoint but below the shoulder.
segments.zh: 用链条或合适的绑带在中点以上、瓶肩以下的位置固定气瓶。

segments.text: Remove the cylinder cap.
segments.zh: 取下瓶帽。

segments.text: Use a cylinder cap hook to help loosen the tight cylinder caps if needed.
segments.zh: 如有需要，可使用瓶帽钩帮助松开拧得很紧的瓶帽。

segments.text: Never apply excessive force to pry off caps.
segments.zh: 切勿用过大的力撬开瓶帽。

segments.text: Make sure to select the correct style of regulator.
segments.zh: 一定要选择正确型号的减压阀。

segments.text: The CGA number on the valve should match the CGA number on the regulator.
segments.zh: 气瓶阀上的 CGA 编号应与减压阀上的 CGA 编号一致。

segments.text: Never use adapters to connect cylinders to regulators.
segments.zh: 切勿使用转接头将气瓶连接到减压阀上。

segments.text: Perform a visual inspection before each use to detect any damage, cracks, corrosion or other defects.
segments.zh: 每次使用前进行目视检查，以发现任何损坏、裂纹、腐蚀或其他缺陷。

segments.text: Ensure the regulator pressure control valve is closed before attaching it to the cylinder.
segments.zh: 在将减压阀连接到气瓶之前，确保减压阀的压力调节阀处于关闭状态。

segments.text: Never use Teflon tape on cylinders or tube fitting connections.
segments.zh: 切勿在气瓶或管接头连接处使用生料带。

segments.text: Thread the regulator into the cylinder.
segments.zh: 将减压阀拧入气瓶。

segments.text: When attaching the regulator, do not stand in line with the regulator and valve outlet.
segments.zh: 连接减压阀时，不要站在减压阀和阀门出口的正对方向上。

segments.text: If the regulator will not fit into the cylinder, this indicates that the incorrect regulator is being used.
segments.zh: 如果减压阀无法与气瓶配合，说明使用的减压阀不对。

segments.text: Tighten first by hand and then use a smooth jawed wrench.
segments.zh: 先用手拧紧，然后使用光面扳手。

segments.text: Do not over and tighten the fitting.
segments.zh: 不要把接头拧得过紧。

segments.text: Most fittings are brass and can be easily warped.
segments.zh: 大多数接头是黄铜的，很容易变形。

segments.text: For flammables or oxidizing gases, ensure your tools are non-sparking.
segments.zh: 对于易燃气体或氧化性气体，确保你的工具是防爆不产生火花的。

segments.text: Pressurize the regulator slowly by opening the main tank valve first.
segments.zh: 先打开气瓶总阀，缓慢地给减压阀加压。

segments.text: Ensure the valve outlets and regulators are pointed away from the personnel when the cylinder valves are open.
segments.zh: 打开气瓶阀时，确保阀门出口和减压阀朝向远离人员的方向。

segments.text: Adjust secondary valve until the proper pressure has been achieved.
segments.zh: 调节二级阀，直到达到合适的压力。

segments.text: Check the connection for leaks using either a bubble or pressure test depending on the type of gas you are using.
segments.zh: 根据所用气体的类型，采用气泡法或压力测试对连接处进行检漏。

segments.text: If there is a leak, close the main tank valve to ensure there is no further leak.
segments.zh: 如果有泄漏，关闭气瓶总阀，确保不再继续泄漏。

segments.text: Then tighten the connection again with a wrench.
segments.zh: 然后用扳手再次拧紧连接处。

segments.text: If the leak remains after the nut is fully tightened, the regulator may need to be replaced.
segments.zh: 如果螺母完全拧紧后仍有泄漏，可能需要更换减压阀。

segments.text: Once the regulator is installed, there are no leaks and the gas supply is connected to your application.
segments.zh: 一旦减压阀安装完毕、没有泄漏，并且气源已连接到你的用气设备上，

segments.text: The gas is now ready for use.
segments.zh: 气体就可以使用了。

segments.text: When using flammable or toxic gases, the relief valve should be vented to a fume hood or other ventilation source.
segments.zh: 使用易燃或有毒气体时，泄压阀应排放到通风橱或其他通风设施中。

segments.text: To improve the lifespan and accuracy of your regulator, do not keep the regulator pressurized when it is not in use.
segments.zh: 为了延长减压阀的使用寿命并提高其准确度，不使用时不要让减压阀保持带压状态。

segments.text: When you are finished working, shut off the main tank valve first.
segments.zh: 工作结束后，先关闭气瓶总阀。

segments.text: Allow the gas to bleed out of the regulator and then close the regulator outlet valve if you have one.
segments.zh: 让气体从减压阀中泄放出来，然后如果有减压阀出口阀，就把它关闭。

segments.text: Before removing the regulator, verify that the cylinder valve is closed and the regulator and the system lines are depressurized.
segments.zh: 在拆卸减压阀之前，确认气瓶阀已关闭，减压阀和系统管路已泄压。

segments.text: To remove the regulator, loosen the nut with a wrench first, then by hand.
segments.zh: 拆卸减压阀时，先用扳手松开螺母，然后再用手拧下。

segments.text: After removing the regulator, replace the cap.
segments.zh: 拆下减压阀后，装回瓶帽。

segments.text: The cap protects the valve while in storage and during transport.
segments.zh: 在储存和运输期间，瓶帽可以保护阀门。

segments.text: For more information about gas cylinders, check out the Gas Cylinder Safety Guidelines Manual linked below.
segments.zh: 有关气瓶的更多信息，请查看下方链接的《气瓶安全指南手册》。

segments.text: If you have questions, please contact ISUEHNS.
segments.zh: 如有疑问，请联系 ISU EH&S。
